About the team

As a Software Engineer on the Vendor Backoffice team within Zillow’s Industry Software organization, you’ll help build the B2B SaaS platforms that support real estate agents, brokers, and vendors. This team owns foundational systems such as vendor onboarding, billing, roster management, and public APIs that help Zillow scale its ecosystem.

About the role

This is an opportunity to grow your career while building the foundational platforms behind Zillow’s business-to-business software ecosystem. You’ll partner with engineering, product, and design to deliver impactful full-stack solutions that support business customers and vendors, while gaining end-to-end ownership of features that improve scale, reliability, and user experience.

You Will Get To:

  • Own full-stack feature development from technical scoping and design through build, testing, rollout, and iteration.

  • Develop and maintain scalable applications across backend services and modern frontend frameworks.

  • Partner cross-functionally with engineering, product, design, and customer success to deliver intuitive workflows and resolve customer-impacting issues.

  • Investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes that improve platform reliability.

  • Continuously enhance products through iterative improvements that elevate the experience for business clients.

  • Contribute to foundational platforms including onboarding, billing, roster management, and API capabilities.

This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are

  • 4+ years of professional full-stack software development experience.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Laravel and PHP, including backend architecture and design patterns.

  • Proven success building and delivering end-to-end features from concept through customer rollout.

  • Comfortable working across the stack, including relational databases such as PostgreSQL and cloud platforms such as AWS.

  • Proficient with modern frontend technologies such as InertiaJS, Vue 3, NextJS, React, and Tailwind CSS.

  • Experience with B2B SaaS products, billing systems, onboarding platforms, or public API integrations is preferred.

  • A builder mindset with strong problem-solving and collaboration skills, plus a focus on customer experience.

  • Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

raw.description:
About Us

Revalue is a carbon credit development platform focused on one of the planet’s most critical but complex challenges - seeing nature regenerated at a planetary scale.

Our mission is to design the most cutting-edge and trusted nature credits for our planet.

We are bringing together a world-class team - forestry experts, ecologists, applied AI scientists, software engineers, geospatial analysts, commercial specialists, economists, and more - to create the unique DNA required to reimagine nature credits.

About the role

We are looking for a highly capable Chief of Staff to work directly alongside our leadership team and help drive the company’s highest-priority strategic and commercial initiatives.

This is a high-impact generalist role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, brings exceptional problem-solving ability, and can move fluidly between strategy and execution. You will help structure complex opportunities, drive strategic special projects, support investor and commercial initiatives, and act as a force multiplier for the leadership team.

The ideal candidate combines consulting-level analytical rigour with startup adaptability, commercial instinct, and a strong understanding of carbon markets and climate-related ecosystems.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Problem Solving & Execution

  • Partner closely with leadership on the company’s highest-priority strategic initiatives, helping turn ambiguity into structured action plans and executable work streams alongside Operations.

  • Lead problem-solving sessions across commercial, investment, and market-facing challenges, bringing clarity, structure, and momentum to complex topics.

  • Take ownership of strategic special projects that require rapid learning, analytical depth, and strong stakeholder management.

Commercial & Carbon Market Development

  • Support development of commercial strategy, market positioning, and proposition design across Revalue’s carbon market activities.

  • Help shape and advance strategic partnerships across the climate, carbon, finance, and supply ecosystem.

  • Develop a strong understanding of carbon markets, nature-based solutions, integrity dynamics, market structures, and evolving buyer needs.

Capital Strategy & Investor Readiness

  • Support leadership on equity fundraising processes, investor engagement, and financing-related strategic initiatives.

  • Build and refine investor materials, strategic narratives, market analyses, and executive-level presentations.

  • Develop financial models, business cases, and analytical frameworks to support strategic and commercial decision-making.

Who you are

Mission-Driven

  • You’re committed to climate impact and aligned with values around integrity, equity, and science-led solutions.

Strategic Generalist

  • You bring broad capabilities across strategy, commercial thinking, financial analysis, communications, and operational execution.

  • You are equally comfortable building a model, creating a board or investor deck, facilitating a workshop, or driving a complex project forward.

Carbon Market & Climate Fluency

  • You have a strong understanding of carbon markets, climate finance, nature-based solutions, or adjacent climate ecosystem dynamics.

  • You understand the commercial realities and strategic opportunities shaping the voluntary carbon market and broader climate ecosystem.

Exceptional Problem Solver

  • You are highly analytical and structured in your thinking, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear frameworks, recommendations, and action plans.

  • You are comfortable leading discussions, synthesising complexity quickly, and helping teams move from uncertainty to execution.

Strong Communicator & Relationship Builder

  • You are an excellent communicator with the ability to engage confidently across investors, partners, governments, customers, and internal teams.

  • You build trust quickly and operate with high judgment, discretion, and integrity.

Startup & High-Growth Experience

  • You thrive in fast-moving environments with high ownership and evolving priorities.

  • You are comfortable operating with limited structure, making decisions with imperfect information, and balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

  • Experience in venture-backed startups, venture capital, growth-stage companies, or high-performance consulting environments is highly valued.

What we offer

  • Shared purpose, culture and values

  • A diverse team of colleagues, partners and clients based all around the world

  • Meaningful equity in an early-stage startup with a growing and trusted brand

  • Significant autonomy and influence at the leadership level

  • The opportunity to shape the future of nature-based climate finance

  • Performance-based variable compensation/commissions

  • Flexible remote working environment with a team deeply committed to impact

  • Generously enhanced, gender-neutral parental leave policy

  • Wellbeing support, including company-funded access to therapy

we make the world better with data

Die Woodmark Consulting GmbH gehört zu den führenden deutschen IT-Beratungsunternehmen für AI, Data & Analytics. Wir begeistern Menschen durch unsere Leidenschaft für Daten & Innovation. Das Leben unserer Werte Respekt, Offenheit, Vertrauen und Fürsorge sorgt für eine ausgezeichnete Unternehmenskultur und ist die Basis unseres Erfolgs.

Nutze auch du deine Leidenschaft für Daten & Innovation und erschließe mit uns deren Potential. So schaffen wir gemeinsam einen Mehrwert für Kunden, Gesellschaft und Umwelt.

deine bunte aufgabenpalette

DevOps wird durchgehend gelebt: Du entwickelst in einem DevOps-Team eigenständig Cloud- und On-prem- Data Pipelines als Fundament von Datenplattformen.

Übersetzen und Umsetzen von Anforderungen: Basierend auf den fachlichen Anforderungen erstellst du technische Data Engineering Konzepte und setzt diese im Code mit um. Dein Wissen über Technologieformen mit passender Werkzeugunterstützung (Coding, ETL, Data Prep, Streaming), datenhaltender Systeme (Blob Stores-, SQL-, NoSQL-, Document-, Node-Datenbanken) und modernste Modellierungstechniken setzt du zielgerichtet dazu ein, Kunden bei Proof of Concepts zu unterstützen und Kundenanforderungen in Projekten zu realisieren.

Verantwortung übernehmen: Kleinere Projekte oder Teilprojekte kannst du als technischer Projektleiter eigenständig durchführen und steuern. Mit deinem Erfahrungsschatz stehst Du unerfahreneren Teammitglieder als Unterstützung im Team zur Seite.

Kommunikation ist das Maß aller Dinge: Du bist stets im intensiven Austausch mit

  • den Fachbereichen und Architekten für projektbezogene Abstimmungen
  • deinen Kunden, um ein professionelles Erwartungsmanagement und deren Zufriedenheit sicherzustellen
  • deinem Projektteam, um den Projekterfolg zu gewährleisten und natürlich
  • dem Woodmark Team, um den Wissensaustausch und die gegenseitige Unterstützung zu stärken.

das hast du auf lager

Projekterfahrung: Du hast mind. 2 Jahre Projekterfahrung, ein gutes Verständnis von Data Engineering Services und Kenntnisse in angrenzenden Services wie Streaming, Machine Learning und Reporting.

Expertise ist selbstverständlich: Du verfügst über

  • Kenntnisse in unterschiedlichen Datenhaltungs-Technologien (SQL-Datenbanken, Data Lake, Lakehouse)
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Python, SQL, JAVA oder Scala
  • Gute Kenntnisse in unterschiedlichen Datenstrukturen (relational, json, xml) und deren Processing-Möglichkeiten (API, Batch, Messaging, Streaming)
  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Datenverarbeitung und -analyse in der Cloud, insbesondere mit AWS Lambda, Glue, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric oder dbt
  • Kenntnisse in Code Version Control sowie CI/CD Pipelines
  • Kenntnisse in Container-Technologien wie Docker

raw.description:
WHO IS RATEHUB?

We’re a company on a mission. We are a unique Canadian Fintech that is the one-stop shop for all financial needs of the consumer: Save, Spend, Borrow, Invest, and Protect. Every single team member — from Product & Engineering to Sales & Marketing, Finance, Operations, and everything in between — is obsessed with one thing: helping Canadians make better financial choices. And we’re pretty great at it, too. Via our digital application technology and our award-winning in-house brokerages, we help over 2M Canadians per month make a positive impact on their finances. We have many unique businesses: a mortgage brokerage, a life insurance brokerage, a home and auto insurance brokerage, a mortgage originations and servicing business, a Financial Services Marketplace, and a content business across Ratehub and MoneySense. 365 days a year, we deliver our users the best online mortgage experience, personalized credit card and loan options, and cheaper auto and home insurance policies than they typically get from their existing financial adviser.

Changing how people make financial choices isn’t easy, though. We know that achieving our mission is full of challenges — challenges that can be complex and often unexpected but that are always interesting, rewarding, and fun to solve as a team. This is where you come in. We are on the hunt for the right candidate to join us and help lead us forward to continued growth.

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our growing team on a 12 month contract, with a possibility of extension: someone who takes end-to-end ownership of the design process, from discovery to final delivery. The ideal candidate is equally strong in UX and UI, passionate about solving user problems, and skilled at transforming high-level ideas into intuitive user experiences that drive real impact. Although headquartered in downtown Toronto, Ratehub is a remote-first company and as such, we’re open to remote candidates.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Core Design:

  • Own the end-to-end design process, from research and ideation to prototyping, validating, and delivering high-impact product experiences that help our users make smart financial decisions.
  • Act as the voice of the customer, using research, usability testing, A/B testing, and other analytical tools to understand and validate ideas, problems, and solutions, ensuring every decision delivers measurable value to users.
  • Partner with product, engineering, data, marketing, and content teams to translate ideas into meaningful, user-centered experiences.
  • Design responsive and consistent experiences across mobile and desktop.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers to ensure design feasibility, high-fidelity implementation, and visual and functional accuracy in the final product.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps and sprint planning alongside product and engineering teams.
  • Build and maintain design backlogs, and help shape design strategy for the next 6–24 months.
  • Support additional design needs from content and marketing initiatives across Ratehub and MoneySense.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Facilitate workshops with stakeholders to align on goals, gather requirements, and co-create solutions.
  • Communicate design concepts and rationale clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

Design Systems and Standards:

  • Build and maintain scalable design systems and style guides to ensure consistency across products.
  • Ensure all designs meet accessibility standards (WCAG) and deliver inclusive user experiences.
  • Stay current with industry trends, tools, and best practices to continuously improve design processes and methodologies.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of product design experience, with a strong portfolio showcasing responsive designs for web and mobile platforms.
  • Proven ability to own the end-to-end design process: user research, ideation, prototyping, UX/UI design, and usability testing.
  • Strong UX and UI design skills, with excellent attention to detail and a deep understanding of how to craft intuitive, impactful user experiences.
  • High proficiency with Figma.
  • Proven ability to leverage both quantitative and qualitative data to validate design decisions, with proficiency in usability testing tools (e.g., usertesting.com, Maze) and analytics tools (e.g., Heap, Hotjar)
  • Highly organized and self-sufficient, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines in a fast-paced, agile environment.
  • Skilled at breaking down complex problems into simple, intuitive solutions and iterating quickly based on feedback.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining scalable, component-based design systems using modern design principles.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to present design rationale and align cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Bias toward action — balancing quality and speed, knowing when to dive deep and when to move quickly
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and experienced in designing 0→1 products and features.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Post-secondary degree, diploma, or certificate in UX Design or a related field.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience working with Storybook or Wordpress.
  • Basic understanding of front-end development (HTML, CSS, Javascript).
  • Experience designing for customer-facing financial services products

CULTURE FIT:

  • Members first - we prioritise the interests and needs of our members above all else.We solve member pain points and focus on member satisfaction. We start with members, and end with the P&L.
  • Growth mindset - we set ambitious goals and challenge the status quo. We take responsible risks and are accountable for our actions.
  • Better together - we are One team with One common goal. We make our footprint bigger than our foot, leave our egos at the door, support each other to achieve great results as One company.
  • Run after problems - we tackle problems head on and focus on finding solutions. Obstacles are seen as opportunities for growth and innovation. We have the hard conversations and choose the harder right over the easier wrong. And we do it with a smile.
  • Measure Learn Iterate Innovate - we focus on getting things done. We measure what matters, iterate, learn, iterate many times in a data-driven way, which is how we will innovate.

JOB PERKS:

  • Competitive Compensation: A salary that reflects your experience and the Canadian market.
  • Remote-First Environment: The flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada, with occasional in-person team gatherings for collaboration.
  • Flexible Hours: Autonomy to manage your schedule to support work-life balance.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health and dental coverage with no employee-paid premiums.
  • RRSP Matching: A company-matched RRSP program to support your long-term financial goals.
  • Professional Development: An individual training allowance to help you grow your skills and career.
  • Team Socials: Regular events, both remote and in-person, to build connections across the organization.

This job posting is for a currently open vacancy.

AI technology is used in the screening and assessment process of our recruitment.

The compensation range for this position is $90,000 - $105,000 CAD.

Find your fit — and your future.

Levi Strauss & Co.’s Global Information Security (GIS) organization is building the next generation of AI-powered security capabilities. The Principal Security Engineer is the technical cornerstone of that effort. This role translates architectural vision into production-grade systems that protect one of the world’s most iconic brands. This opportunity sits within the GIS, reporting to the Directory of AI & Security Engineering, who reports directly to the CISO. You will architect and build the agentic platform that powers our threat intelligence automation, detection engineering assistance, and security alert triage. This role is operating at the intersection of enterprise software engineering, AI systems design, and cybersecurity at global scale.

About the Job

  • Support the enterprise agentic AI platform, defining and governing how every agent at LS&Co. is built, deployed, and governed, regardless of cloud provider, model, or builder team.
  • Architect and engineer a production-grade multi-agent AI platform to orchestrate specialized security agents across the GIS.
  • Lead the design and implementation of the AI Gateway as the central enforcement point for all LLM and agent traffic.
  • Architect the agent identity and registry system to eliminate shadow AI and orphaned agents across the estate.
  • Establish the audit and observability architecture for agent workloads.
  • Own cross-platform guardrails and data protection standards.
  • Build AI-powered enrichment and analysis pipelines integrated with our security stack.
  • Define engineering standards, design review processes, and architectural patterns for the AI & Security Engineering practice.
  • Establish organizational accountability structures for platform component ownership, partnering with Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security to define clear ownership boundaries, contribution standards, and governance operating models that scale beyond a single team.

About You

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with expert proficiency in Python; demonstrated track record designing and delivering complex, distributed, cloud-native systems at scale.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping agentic AI applications beyond proof-of-concept
  • Practical proficiency with AI orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangChain, ADK, etc.) and RAG pipeline design, including embedding strategies, hybrid search, and LLM evaluation methodology.
  • Solid grasp of security operations concepts: threat intelligence workflows, detection engineering and SIEM query languages (KQL, SPL, YARA-L, etc.), MITRE ATT&CK, vulnerability management, and API-based integration with security platforms.
  • Strong architecture and leadership instincts: you write RFCs, lead design reviews, make well-reasoned build-vs-buy decisions, and can communicate technical complexity to both engineering peers and executive audiences.
  • Operates effectively as a principal-level individual contributor who is comfortable driving technical alignment without direct organizational authority.
  • Genuine, demonstrable passion for AI and agentic systems; not just aware of the landscape, but actively experimenting, building, and thinking about what AI can and cannot reliably do today.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD in regulated or high-assurance environments; familiarity with cloud security best practices including managed identity, Key Vault, and least-privilege design.

Join Our Team: Do Meaningful Work and Improve People’s Lives

Our purpose, to improve customers’ lives by making healthcare work better, is far from ordinary. And so are our employees. Working at Premera means you have the opportunity to drive real change by transforming healthcare.

Premera is committed to being a workplace where people feel empowered to grow, innovate, and lead with purpose. By investing in our employees and fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous development, we’re able to better serve our customers. It’s this commitment that has earned us recognition as one of the best companies to work for. Learn more about our recent awards and recognitions as a greatest workplace.

Learn how Premera supports our members, customers and the communities that we serve through our Healthsource blog: https://healthsource.premera.com/.

About the role of the Business Analyst III

Help redefine how claims work gets done—at scale and with purpose. As a Business Analyst III, you’ll assist in the design and operational delivery of automation and AI-enabled workflow solutions that replace manual, repetitive work with reliable digital decisioning. You’ll partner across Product, Technology, and Configuration to build well-controlled process automations, performance dashboards, and data-driven improvements that shorten cycle times, strengthen accuracy, and elevate the member experience. The Business Analyst III is responsible for redesigning workflows rather than manually supporting inefficiencies; identifying opportunities to automate manual business analyst activities; define high-quality business requirements and acceptance criteria; conduct UAT and support production stabilization; and, operate within Claims Optimization rather than fragmented operational support.

What you’ll do:

  • Translates ambiguous business needs into solid business and functional requirements for small to large projects with moderate complexity.
  • Effectively elicits information to create concise, organized Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement Documents (FRD) using standard, industry recognized tools and best practices. Manages requirements across the lifecycle of a project to ensure end user satisfaction, business stakeholder buy-in, and scope integrity.
  • Identifies opportunities and contributes recommendations based on analysis of requirements and future impacts.
  • Partners with business unit and IT or other departments as needed to ensure successful implementation and ongoing business and / or systems support when appropriate.
  • Creates detailed Use Cases, User Stories and other documents to illustrate business needs.
  • Facilitate meetings and Joint Application Development (JAD) sessions in a positive way to drive cross functional stakeholders to reach agreements and effective solutions. Meetings may include leadership.
  • Conducts research and interviews subject matter experts to create "As-is" and "To-be" process flows. Apply critical thinking to evaluate cross functional dependencies, including upstream and downstream impacts.
  • Contributes to enhancements of Business Analysis best practices and suggestions for improvements.
  • Creates business facing test scenarios, test scripts/cases, and mockups of data necessary to conduct testing. Creates the traceability between requirements and scenarios to ensure business requirements are met. May monitor and report on testing activity and results.
  • Consults with others in the development of appropriate training materials to support the needs of functional areas.
  • May provide support to other entry and junior level Business Analysts.
  • May investigate and research system problems and enhancements, working collaboratively with IT and business stakeholders to identify options and provide business and / or technical solutions.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What you’ll bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four (4) years’ work experience. (Required)
  • Three (3) years of analytical experience in a technical or business environment, including at least 2 years performing business analysis functions (gathering business requirements, documenting process/data flows, and performing gap analyses). (Required)
  • Experience scaling automation across multiple workflows or operational areas using repeatable delivery patterns. (Preferred)
  • Familiarity with claims operations or similar process‑driven domains. (Preferred)
  • Experience building dashboards and operational reporting using Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent BI tools. (Preferred)
  • Experience using SQL for data analysis (Preferred)
  • Fluency using AI tools such as Copilot for drafting requirements, analyzing data, summarizing stakeholder input, or accelerating documentation workflows. (Preferred)
  • Experience with Lean methodology or Six Sigma. (Preferred)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Visio, or Sharepoint. (Preferred)
  • Experience in healthcare or other regulated industries. (Preferred)
  • Experience in a project environment that utilizes Agile or Waterfall methodologies. (Preferred)

Premera total rewards

Our comprehensive total rewards package provides support, resources, and opportunities to help employees thrive and grow. Our total rewards are more than a collection of perks, they're a reflection of our commitment to your health and well-being. We offer a broad array of rewards including physical, financial, emotional, and community benefits, including:

  • Medical, vision, and dental coverage with low employee premiums.

  • Voluntary benefit offerings, including pet insurance for paw parents.

  • Life and disability insurance.

  • Retirement programs, including a 401K employer match and, believe it or not, a pension plan that is vested after 3 years of service.

  • Wellness incentives with a wide range of mental well-being resources for you and your dependents, including counseling services, stress management programs, and mindfulness programs, just to name a few.

  • Generous paid time off to reenergize.

  • Looking for continuing education? We have tuition assistance for both undergraduate and graduate degrees.

  • Employee recognition program to celebrate anniversaries, team accomplishments, and more.

For our hybrid employees, our on-campus model provides flexibility to create your own routine with access to on-site resources, networking opportunities, and team engagement.

  • Commuter perks make your trip to work less impactful on the environment and your wallet.

  • Free convenient on-site parking.

  • Subsidized on-campus cafes make lunchtime connections with colleagues fun and affordable.

  • Participate in engaging on-site activities such as health and wellness events, coffee connects, disaster preparedness fairs and more.

  • Our complementary fitness & well-being center offers both in-person and virtual workouts and nutritional counseling.

  • Need a brain break? Challenge someone to a game of shuffleboard or ping pong while on campus.

About the opportunity Help modernize and scale the workflow platform behind Dayforce. We’re looking for a Software Developer II to join the Dayforce Platform Extensibility team and contribute to the evolution of one of the most critical systems in Dayforce: Workflow. Our mission is to build scalable, extensible platform capabilities that reduce duplication and enable teams to move faster. At the heart of what we build is the Dayforce Workflow platform — a scalable, rule-based workflow orchestration engine powering employee lifecycle processes across a multi-tenant SaaS platform used by millions globally. We’re evolving Workflow into a reusable platform service with extensible APIs that support workflow capabilities across multiple Dayforce domains. As part of that evolution, we’re also investing in AI-enabled orchestration and intelligent automation experiences integrated directly into the platform. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy solving backend and platform engineering challenges, building scalable systems, and growing their technical depth within large-scale enterprise software. This is a full-stack role with a strong backend focus, where much of the work involves distributed systems, backend services, APIs, scalability, and platform engineering. What you'll get to do

  • Contribute to core capabilities within the Dayforce Workflow platform and help deliver scalable workflow experiences across Dayforce
  • Design and build backend services, APIs, and platform capabilities that support reusable workflow orchestration across multiple business domains
  • Contribute to AI-enabled orchestration and intelligent automation initiatives, leveraging AI-assisted tooling and modern development workflows to improve engineering productivity
  • Improve the scalability, reliability, and maintainability of workflow systems, distributed services, and backend infrastructure
  • Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and platform modernization efforts across the team
  • Build clean, maintainable, and well-tested code while following modern engineering standards and development practices
  • Collaborate closely with teammates to troubleshoot issues, improve system quality, and continuously evolve the platform

What will help you succeed

AI & Modern Development Tooling

  • Experience building, experimenting with, or integrating AI-enabled applications, workflows, or developer tooling
  • Familiarity with modern AI frameworks, LLM-based tooling, or AI-assisted development workflows
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent to improve development productivity
  • Interest in applying AI as a practical force multiplier within modern software development

Backend & Platform Engineering

  • Experience building and maintaining applications using C#/.NET and modern backend development practices
  • Experience designing or contributing to backend services, APIs, or platform capabilities
  • Strong understanding of SQL Server fundamentals, query performance, and troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, scalable application design, and backend performance considerations
  • Comfortable working within larger interconnected codebases and contributing to mature enterprise systems
  • Familiarity with Azure and modern cloud development patterns

Engineering Mindset

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams
  • Solid problem-solving and debugging skills across backend systems and application services
  • Experience with modern development workflows, CI/CD practices, testing, and code reviews
  • Demonstrates ownership, continuous learning, and a willingness to grow technical expertise
  • Passion for writing clean, maintainable code and contributing positively to team engineering culture

Job Description:

Job Description

At Sparklight/Cableone and our Cable One family of brands, we keep our customers and associates connected to what matters most. For our associates, that means: a thriving and rewarding career, respect for the communities where they live and work, a focus on health and wellness, an excellent work/life balance, and an open and inclusive workplace.

We are open to hiring remote if we find the right talent in any of the following states: AL, AR, AZ, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, LA, MD,MO, MS, NC, ND, NE, NM, NV, OR, OK, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT.

Join Sparklight's Business Team as a Service Delivery Fulfillment Specialist! You will be responsible for managing new orders, entering customer data, scheduling installations, and making sure our customers are happy with the installation and products when the install has been completed.

What you will do to contribute to the company's success

  • Responsible for post-sale order entry process, including HSD, video, and native and ported telephone lines.
  • Receives orders from business sales representatives, verifies accuracy, and gathers information from customer.
  • Facilitates communications between customers and sales associates with a focus on quality assurance and customer satisfaction.
  • Enters orders in software platforms, while maintaining contact with business customers, dispatchers, Level 3, and local office teams throughout installation process.
  • Manages multiple projects, including escalations, at various stages of completion, ensuring accuracy and detailed follow-through.
  • Creates service tickets and notates Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools for all orders.
  • Other duties and/or responsibilities not specifically set forth above may, however, be assigned as needed. Whenever practicable and, in accordance with legal guidelines, reasonable accommodation[s] will be made to enable an otherwise qualified individual with a disability to perform the essential functions of the position.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); and one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Previous experience within cable industry, specifically in the areas of Competitive Local Exchange Carrier (C-LEC), Incumbent Local Exchange Carrier (I-LEC), and Business-to-Business (B2B) preferred.
  • Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, percentages, adjustments, commissions, Early Termination Fees (ETF), and Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Valid driver’s license and a good driving record.
  • Intermediate skill in essential software applications, including Outlook, Excel, and Word required.
  • Strong customer service skills with emphasis on phones and data entry required.
  • High level of accountability and detail orientation required.
  • Knowledgeable in Salesforce.com and Single View preferred.
  • Understanding of ROI and beginner knowledge of port process preferred.

Core Competencies

  • Committed: Values each and every customer, while working hard to keep their business and support our communities.
  • Helpful: Delivers support in the ways that are most useful to our customers and addresses their needs with expertise, respect, and empathy.
  • Proactive: Understand what our customers need, and actively works to make their relationship with use seamless, easy, and rewarding.
  • Personal: Knows our customers well, and tailors our communications and interactions to address their needs and expectations.

Benefits

Cable One and our family of brands appreciates the role our associates play to help the company grow, and in return an excellent benefits package is offered to our associates to recognize the importance of their contributions, such as:

  • Medical, dental, and vision plans – start when you start!
  • Life insurance (self, spouse, children)
  • Paid time off (vacation, holiday, and personal/sick days)
  • 401(k) - 100% company match (match program starts after 1 year of service, up to 5% of eligible compensation)
  • Group Legal plan with Identity Theft Protection

Additional Perks

  • Tuition reimbursement (up to $5,250 on 1st year)
  • Up to seventy-five dollars a month towards cable and internet services
  • Annual community support to various organizations across the U.S.
  • Associate recognition & awards programs
  • Advancement opportunities
  • Collaborative work environment

Our Commitment

Diversity lies in the communities we serve and among the associates who dedicate themselves to ensure our continued success. Here at Cable One and our family of brands, we believe it is our individual and unique talents, backgrounds and perspectives that, when combined, truly make us an unstoppable force. "Stronger Together" is not just a verbal cue, it is the motto that our associates live by, exemplify, and embody each and every day.

Cable One and our family of brands is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, status as a protected veteran, or disability.

Pre-hire Processes

Cable One and our family of brands is committed to keeping our associates and customers safe. Job offers are contingent upon the results of background, drug screening, and reference check. Only after successfully passing these pre-hire clearances are individuals approved for hire and ready to start their successful and rewarding career.

was solltest du mitbringen?

warum wir?

Das spiegelt sich nicht nur in unserem selbstverantwortlichen Handeln wider, sondern auch im absolut liebevollen und achtsamen Umgang miteinander.

Für unsere Vision gehen wir mit einem hohen gemeinsamen Commitment los, um so kraftvoll und mit Klarheit eine großartige Zukunft zu erschaffen – für jedes Teammitglied und für alle Menschen, die mit uns daran glauben.

Unter anderem erwarten dich folgende Benefits bei uns, die sich an unseren gemeinsamen Werten orientieren:

  • Wir arbeiten remote | Unser Büro befindet sich in Berlin. Um mit den besten Talenten arbeiten zu können, sind unsere Mitarbeitende an keinen festen Arbeitsplatz gebunden. Wir stellen dir die technische Ausstattung zur Verfügung, die du zur Einrichtung deines Arbeitsplatzes benötigst.
  • Wir investieren in deine Weiterentwicklung | Zur individuellen Förderung deiner Skills erhältst du nach der Probezeit ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und bis zu fünf Tage Bildungszeit zur freien Verfügung. Regelmäßiges, kompetenz-, werte- und stärkenorientiertes 360° Feedback ist ein Grundpfeiler unserer Zusammenarbeit.
  • Wir setzen auf Vertrauen | Vertrauen und verantwortungsbewusstes Handeln sind Grundpfeiler unserer Unternehmenskultur. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und einer unbegrenzten Anzahl an Urlaubstagen fördern wir diese und bieten dir echte Work-Life-Balance.
  • Wir fördern Zusammenhalt und wachsen individuell | Um persönliche Begegnungen und einen teamübergreifenden Austausch zu ermöglichen, investiert das Unternehmen in einzigartige Teamveranstaltungen, gemeinsame Erfahrungen und spirituelle Weiterentwicklung. Hierfür nehmen wir uns mindestens zweimal im Jahr ausgiebig Zeit.
  • Wir übernehmen Verantwortung | Unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge setzt auf nachhaltige und ökologische Fonds und wird mit 15 % bezuschusst. Für Eltern bieten wir zehn Tage volle Lohnfortzahlung, wenn dein Kind einmal krank sein sollte.

Da uns viele Bewerbungen erreichen, können wir allerdings nur auf dich zurückkommen, wenn wir eine passende Möglichkeit für dich sehen. Wir bedanken uns für dein Verständnis und das Vertrauen, das du uns mit deiner Bewerbung entgegenbringst.

Um den Vorgaben der Datenschutz-Grundverordnung (DSGVO) zu entsprechen, bewahren wir deine Unterlagen standardmäßig 6 Monate lang auf. Within Rich Media, the VSAI team is building systems that transform home media into products that enrich the understanding of a home.

About the role

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who loves operating at the intersection of modeling and systems. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll help shape how Zillow builds production-grade machine learning systems for rich media experiences, partnering across applied science and engineering to turn promising ideas into reliable, scalable product capabilities.

You Will Get To:

  • Productionalization:Owning the transition from research code to production-ready and optimized models. Establishing CI/CD pipelines that allow scientists to deploy models in short iteration cycles. Innovating upon our existing monitoring systems that make our services reliable and give scientists insight into the performance of their models in production. Designing services to expose ML models to Zillow’s end customers

  • Data: Good data is key to many SOTA ML methods. You will own our team’s datasets, lead and support data engineering projects, understand datasets from other teams, and collaborate with scientists and other teams to prepare them for model training.

  • Training & Experimentation:Owning projects and supporting scientists in running large-scale training and data processing by collaborating with them on specific projects, establishing generalized best practices, and sharing expertise around performance and software engineering principles, while leveraging AI coding and productivity tools.

  • Modeling: Staying on top of cutting-edge research (for example, on platforms like Arxiv, X, and Papers With Code) and modifying its methods for our use cases in innovative ways to enable new product experiences or improve existing ones.

  • Dev & MLOps:Establishing best practices around code quality, testing, and ownership that allow us to move fast without compromising reliability (and sleep). Participating in our existing on-call rotation

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • You have 1-3 years professional experience building and shipping machine learning models or ML-powered systems in production.

  • You have strong hands-on proficiency in Python and at least one modern machine learning framework, such as PyTorch, JAX or TensorFlow.

  • You have hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • You have experience with data engineering tools and building robust data pipelines (e.g., Spark, Airflow, streaming systems)

  • You have experience using backend code languages such as TypeScript or Go to fully implement ML-powered systems end-to-end

  • You have experience building and operating end-to-end machine learning workflows, including data pipelines, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

  • You have a strong foundation in machine learning fundamentals such as representation learning, structured prediction, computer vision, optimization, and failure analysis.

  • You are comfortable debugging model and system behavior in real-world environments and using metrics, logs, and experiments to improve outcomes.

  • You collaborate effectively with applied scientists, software engineers, and product partners in ambiguous, cross-functional settings.

  • You have strong engineering judgment and know how to balance experimentation with reliability, speed, and long-term maintainability.

  • You communicate technical ideas clearly and can influence decisions across disciplines.

Nice to have

  • Experience in computer vision, spatial data, 3D, AR/VR, or related domains is a plus.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

job description

Unleash your potential and join the team redefining the future of administration!

Who We Are

At SmartPA, we don’t just provide support – we transform it.

Our mission is simple yet bold: to redefine administrative and PA services through innovative thinking, cutting-edgetechnologyand an unrelenting pursuit of excellence. Trusted by global leaders in industries like tech, automotive and retail, we’re the engine behind smarter, more efficient operations.

With a vibrant, client-focused culture and a team driven by creativity, no two days at SmartPA are ever the same! As we continue to grow rapidly, this is your opportunity to join us on the journey to becoming the most optimised administrative organisation in the world.

If you’re ready to challenge the status quo and create meaningful impact, we want to hear from you!

key responsibilities and skills

What You’ll Do

The Centre of Excellence (COE) is the driving force behindSmartPA, where strategy comes to life. As part of this dynamic, client-facing department, you’ll be the heartbeat of our business – delivering high-impact, tailored support to a key client account daily.

In the role of Business Support Executive, you’ll play a pivotal role in providing bespoke solutions to a variety of stakeholders. You’ll tackle real challenges, establish meaningful relationships and make a tangible difference to client success.

Here’s what your day-to-day will look like:

Collaborate & Innovate

  • Work within our agile pod structure to deliver comprehensive and seamless support across a variety of tasks and projects for stakeholders.
  • Contribute fresh, creative ideas to optimise processes, streamline workflows, and enhance service delivery.
  • Partner with your team to ensure exceptional service delivery, meeting client needs and driving measurable results.

Manage Key Tasks with Excellence

  • Complete tasks such as diary management, scheduling and handling email correspondence with precision and professionalism, keeping everything on track for your client.
  • Prepare, format and edit documents to meet the highest standards, ensuring consistency and quality in every deliverable.
  • Perform accurate data entry and reporting, ensuring all insights are actionable and timely.

Support Business Growth

  • Identify inefficiencies and proactively recommend process improvements, helping us work smarter.
  • Assist in creating workflows, automating repetitive tasks and embedding best practices across your client’s operations.

Be a Relationship Builder

  • Act as a trusted partner to your client, anticipating needs and consistently exceeding expectations.
  • Represent SmartPA’s values with authenticity, serving as a positive brand ambassador in every interaction.
  • Collaborate across teams to ensure consistent quality and excellence in all deliverables.

Stay Adaptable

  • Approach new challenges with a solution-driven mindset, thriving in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

experience

About You

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Thrives in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where no two days are the same.
  • Is passionate about redefining what it means to deliver world-class PA and admin support.
  • Can manage their own time and workload effectively, delivering results with confidence.
  • Brings enthusiasm, creativity, and positivity to their work.
  • Enjoys contributing ideas to improve processes and drive business growth.

What You’ll Need

Your experience is key, but your attitude is what sets you apart.

Essential:

  • Proficiency in MS Office (especially Outlook, Word, and Excel).
  • Proven experience in diary management, data handlingand project coordination.
  • A track record of meeting tight deadlines and juggling competing priorities.

Desirable:

  • Familiarity with Google Suite, CRM platforms and booking systems.
  • Background in office management, account management, or similar.
  • Experience in process improvement and creating efficiencies.

work remotely

Yes.

salary

£25,000 - £35,000

schedule

Monday - Friday, 9am - 5.30pm (core hours are 10am - 4.30pm)

what's in it for you?

What’s in It for You?

At SmartPA, we believe in rewarding talent and supporting your growth:

  • Competitive Salaries
  • Yearly Bonuses based on company, department, and individual performance.
  • Remote Work.
  • Flexitime Initiative: Work when you’re most productive (core hours: 10:00–16:30).
  • 33 Days Holiday: Because rest fuels greatness.
  • Growth Opportunities: Develop your skills, advance your career and grow with a company reshaping the industry.

Join PacificSource and help our members access quality, affordable care!

PacificSource is an equal opportunity employer. Provide excellent customer service primarily by telephone to all PacificSource customers. Assist customers with coverage/claims related questions. Essential Responsibilities:

Building Customer Loyalty

Contributing to Team Success

Planning and Organizing

Continuous Improvement

Adaptability

Vous pouvez résider n'importe où au Canada à condition d'être titulaire d'un permis d'expert en sinistres valide au Québec (sinistres des particuliers et des entreprises).

Anglais fonctionnel est requis (oral et écrit).

Résumé du rôle

Nous cherchons actuellement à ajouter un expert en dommage directs et responsabilité civile (1 à 3 années d'expérience) à notre équipe des comptes nationaux !!

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, le candidat idéal doit avoir une formation/expérience dans les réclamations en dommages directs et en responsabilité civile. Le candidat aura aussi de l'expérience en blessures corporelles ou au moins de l'intérêt pour en traiter.

  • Enquêter sur la cause et faire rapport aux clients avec des recommandations solides.

  • Tout au long du processus de réclamation, fournir un service à la clientèle de haut niveau aux clients et aux assurés.

  • Exécuter les tâches qui lui sont confiées conformément aux normes de travail, politiques et procédures établies.

Compétences requises pour réussir:

  • Compétences analytiques efficaces, y compris l'identification des dynamiques de cause à effet.

  • Capable de tirer des conclusions valables et de les communiquer efficacement.

Pourquoi devriez-vous envisager une carrière avec IndemniPro? Nous sommes fiers de nos employés et cela montre :

  • Si vous ne désirez pas travailler de la maison à temps plein, notre bureau local vous accueillera, vous fournira un bureau agréable, des collègues sympathiques et un endroit pour développer votre carrière.

Avec plus de 90 succursales au Canada, IndemniPro est le plus important fournisseur de services de gestion de réclamations, d'un océan à l'autre. Nos professionnels en sinistres offrent un large éventail d'expertises dans de multiples disciplines et s'engagent à fournir un service de la plus haute qualité à nos clients. Nous et nos sociétés affiliées accueillons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes handicapées. Des aménagements sont disponibles sur demande pour les candidats tout au long du processus de recrutement et d’évaluation.

Nous et nos sociétés affiliées n’acceptons pas les CV non sollicités envoyés par des recruteurs tiers et demandons par la présente aux agences de ne pas contacter directement nos employés ou nos gestionnaires afin de leur présenter des candidats. Nous acceptons uniquement les CV soumis directement par les candidats.

We have an existing opportunity for a property & liability claims adjuster! This position is 100% remote, but an office awaits you in Laval if you prefer to work in hybrid mode. You can live anywhere in Canada if you have a valid Quebec claims adjuster's license (personal and commercial).

Bilingualism in French and English is required (oral and written).

Role Summary

We are currently looking to add a Direct Damage & Liability (including BI) Adjuster (1-3 years experience) to our National Accounts team!!

To be successful in this role, the ideal candidate will have training/experience in direct damage and liability claims. The candidate will ideally have experience in Bodily injury claims.

Responsibilities:

  • Prompt contact and follow up with policy holders and claimants.

  • Investigate the cause and report to clients with solid recommendations.

  • Identify liability exposures, recommend reserves, recommend investigation required for exposure, prepare action plans, and negotiate fair and satisfactory settlements.

  • Throughout the claims process, provide high level of customer service to clients and the insured.

  • Perform duties assigned to him/her in compliance with established work standards, policies and procedures.

Competencies required to succeed:

  • Proactive in finding resolutions, with sense of urgency and responsiveness.

  • Effective analytical skills including identification of cause-and-effect dynamics.

  • Able to draw valid conclusions and effectively communicate them.

  • Demonstrated organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage conflicting priorities in an effective manner.

  • Ability to handle pressure with a calm demeanor, especially during conflict and difficult situations.

  • Must have people skills with bias towards building relationships with own team and claims stakeholders.

  • Proficient with computers and current technology

  • Effective written skills including grammar and those of a technical in nature.

  • Effective oral skills, including listening, interviewing, negotiating, etc.; Must be able to flex style appropriate to audience.

  • Excellent customer service skills and ensures that all inquiries are effectively dealt with in a timely manner.

  • Bilingualism (English & French) is a strong asset

Why should you consider a career with ClaimsPro? We are proud of our people, and it shows:

  • You will be part of a team of over 700 independent adjusters from across Canada.

  • Your career can grow into other lines of claims, branch management, across Canada into other branches, or new roles - the sky is the limit.

  • You will work on the industry-leading Claim Space software, designed by an adjuster for adjusters and kept modern with our in-house team of programmers and developers.

  • Your claims load is driven by senior executives and business development staff from coast to coast.

  • You will be entitled to a multitude of benefits such as education fee reimbursement, reimbursement of your annual license(s) renewal; mentorship programs and a flex-benefit health and dental plan that allows you to customize your coverage.

  • Opportunity for you to obtain your claims adjuster license in all Canadian provinces.

  • If you do not want to work from home, our local office will welcome you, provide you with a nice office, friendly coworkers, and a place to grow your career.

With over 90 branches in Canada, ClaimsPro is the largest supplier of claims management services, coast to coast. Our claims professionals offer a broad range of expertise across multiple disciplines and are committed to providing the highest quality of service to our clients. Visit www.scm.ca or www.claimspro.ca to learn more.

Environment/Work Conditions

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates throughout the recruitment and assessment process.

Unsolicited Outreach Statement – Recruitment Agencies

We will not accept unsolicited resume submittals from third- party recruiters and hereby request agencies not to contact our employees or managers directly to present candidates. Be advised we will NOT pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume and will consider any unsolicited resumes forwarded public information. A Mosaic Company valoriza a diversidade, a inclusão e o desenvolvimento contínuo. Igualdade e oportunidades a todos fazem parte do dia a dia dos nossos profissionais, que encontrarão aqui a trilha ideal para desenvolver suas carreiras. Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

Ciclo de Vida de Aplicações e Governança

  • Liderar os processos de ciclo de vida de aplicações ponta a ponta, desde a entrada (intake) até a desativação, garantindo alinhamento com arquitetura corporativa, segurança e padrões de compliance.

  • Estabelecer e assegurar a aplicação de frameworks de governança, KPIs e metodologias em todas as equipes de Digital Delivery.

  • Promover consistência nos processos de SDLC, práticas Ágeis/DevOps, padrões de testes e gestão de releases.

  • Fornecer supervisão estratégica para decisões relacionadas ao ciclo de vida, incluindo upgrades, consolidações e descontinuação de sistemas.

  • Atuar em parceria com arquitetura corporativa para garantir escalabilidade, sustentabilidade e alinhamento técnico.

Integração de Fusões e Aquisições (M&A)

  • Liderar todas as atividades relacionadas a aplicações em processos de M&A, incluindo levantamento de sistemas, due diligence técnica, planejamento de integração, migração e estabilização.

  • Avaliar riscos, identificar dependências de processos e sistemas e garantir integração fluida ao ecossistema da Mosaic.

  • Colaborar com stakeholders-chave (Segurança, Infraestrutura, Tecnologia do Negócio, Times de Produto) para assegurar a continuidade do negócio durante as transições.

Garantia da Qualidade e Governança de Testes

  • Definir e liderar a estratégia de QA em todo o portfólio de Digital Delivery.

  • Gerenciar equipes responsáveis por testes automatizados, testes manuais, testes de performance e ciclos de regressão.

  • Supervisionar pipelines de testes integrados ao CI/CD, garantindo entregas robustas e confiáveis.

  • Implementar melhorias contínuas de qualidade e garantir aderência a controles internos e requisitos de auditoria.

Serviços Gerenciados de Aplicações (Suporte Níveis L1 e L2)

  • Supervisionar as operações globais de suporte de aplicações nível 1 e nível 2, garantindo resolução ágil de incidentes, solicitações de serviço e problemas.

  • Gerenciar equipes internas e parceiros externos para assegurar conformidade com SLAs e KPIs.

  • Liderar iniciativas de monitoramento proativo, gestão de problemas, análise de causa raiz e otimização de serviços.

  • Garantir que documentação, bases de conhecimento e processos de suporte estejam atualizados e eficazes.

Desativação de Aplicações

  • Garantir retenção de dados, conformidade de arquivamento e mitigação de riscos durante a desativação.

  • Reduzir dívida técnica identificando aplicações redundantes, obsoletas ou de baixo valor.

  • Coordenar a execução com equipes multifuncionais (arquitetura, segurança, dados, infraestrutura e produto).

Governança e Liderança de Digital Delivery

  • Fornecer supervisão de governança para todas as linhas de produto de Digital Delivery (SAP, Comercial, Manufatura, Supply Chain, Aplicações Corporativas, etc.).

  • Garantir disciplina de processos, excelência operacional e qualidade consistente entre equipes de entrega.

  • Atuar em parceria com a liderança sênior para conduzir priorização de portfólio, visibilidade de performance e alinhamento estratégico.

Job Title: Key Account Manager
Reports to: Associate Vice President, Sales
FLSA Class: Exempt

Learn more about our company and how we support you:

The surgical robot that assists a surgeon. The autonomous vehicle that navigates a warehouse floor. The train control system that keeps thousands of commuters on schedule. Somewhere inside that technology is an ADLINK product.

Ampro ADLINK Technology designs and manufactures embedded computing hardware for industries where failure is not an option.  Industrial automation, robotics, autonomous vehicles, healthcare, and intelligent transportation are just some of the markets we serve. Our products sit at the edge of these systems, processing data and providing real-time control where it happens, when it happens, not in a distant cloud.

Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Taiwan, we operate across the US, UK, Singapore, China, Japan, Korea, and Germany with products deployed in more than 40 countries. Our San Jose office drives our business across the Americas and works closely with technology partners, including Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, and NXP.

If you are an experienced sales professional who wants to sell to some of the most exciting companies in the world, autonomous vehicle manufacturers, casino gaming platforms, medical device makers, robotics innovators, and more, ADLINK gives you a genuine competitive edge. Our technology is deeply embedded in our customers' products, which means long-term relationships, recurring business, and deals that are worth winning.


Job Summary:

The right individual is a talented, experienced, and highly competitive sales professional that thrives in an outbound proactive prospecting role and will be responsible for evangelizing, promoting, and selling ADLINK’s products to new and existing customers within a region.

The successful candidate will play a fundamental role in achieving our customer acquisition and revenue growth objectives in the Central US territory.

The Key Account Manager is a remote
Approximately 50% travel may be required.

Essential Job Functions (include, but are not limited to the following):
  • Develop new OEM accounts.
  • Design and implement sales strategies to ensure the company meets its revenue and design win objectives.
  • Use insight and consultative selling techniques to teach customers about their industry and offer unique perspectives on their business, which link back to ADLINK’s solutions.
  • Research prospective organizations and identify the right customer stakeholders to sell to.
  • Coach customer stakeholders and build consensus for ADLINK solutions within their organization.
  • Leverage the Challenger Sales methodology and an insights-driven sales processes, along with a current knowledge of industry and technical trends, to customize solutions for customer needs and business goals.
  • Independently and collaboratively strategize for solving deal level challenges.
  • Regularly update an accurate and robust pipeline of business opportunities and forecasts in SFDC with latest customer information and use customer intelligence for account planning.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly territory sales forecasts and maintain your sales pipeline.
  • Track weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance and sales metrics.
  • Experience aligning business outcomes and initiatives with technology requirements.
  • Manage rep partners.
  • Support and manage the relationships with all assigned customers, ensuring high customer satisfaction.
  • Cooperate in the annual planning process with Sales management, setting key objectives: design win and revenue targets, new customer targets, new opportunity creation goals, etc.
  • Customer visits including giving technical presentations and product overviews to customers.
  • As a trusted advisor, build in-depth knowledge of clients’ business priorities, challenges and initiatives that can be translated into additional ADLINK opportunities.
  • This a remote role, but travel is required in this role (customer meetings within territory, annual sales events, etc.).

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.

Experience:

  • 3+ years of work experience in any industry.

Competencies:

  • Strategic Thinking - Systematically solves problems and hypothesizes possible customer pain points, expectations, and implicit needs; brainstorms with team members to devise solutions to solve complex deal challenges.
  • Communication - Tailors communication to the customer’s needs with authority; effectively delivers presentations and has strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Interpersonal Influence - Uses rational and emotion drives that would appeal to customers to drive negotiation conversations in his or her favor.
  • Networking - Identifies the right customer stakeholders and builds connections quickly to drive consensus for deals; works cooperatively with a wide range of internal stakeholders for deal success.
  • Workflow Management - Highly organized with a rapid, yet methodical approach. Sets clear time-bound objectives that align with business growth.
  • Negotiation - Experience in large complex deal negotiations with a successful track record.
  • Ownership - Goes out of his or her way to complete a job with relentless drive to achieve results; is independent and self-directed.

Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance.
  • Life, AD&D, Short Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability insurance.
  • 401k retirement plan
  • HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA
  • Vacation and Sick Leave.
  • Paid holidays and floating holidays.
Physical Demands and Work Environment (The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by the individual to successfully perform the functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the job functions):
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit; regularly use hands to handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; talk and hear; and doing things such as analytical work or reports, which requires focus, while utilizing a computer.
  • Must be able to operate general office equipment.
  • Physical stamina to stand, reach, bend, lift, grasp, and kneel.
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate.
